summary.prose: Building this Story adds one shared check to the team author gate and calls it before the first write of the two content writers that had no gate: the define run that extends an existing Epic and the review-comment recorder. The write inventory then names the gate behind every content writer, with a test that fails for one that has none. The work ends with the decisions recorded and one full sweep.

tasks.title: Add the shared revise-or-author check to the author gate
tasks.summary: Add assertMayReviseDraft(repoPath, unit, stage, authoring) to src/workflow/team/author-gate.ts: it asks teamGate for 'revise' when isUnderSignoff(repoPath, unit, stage) holds and for 'author' otherwise, keeps the first-author exception for a stage with no issue, applies assertHeld for 'revise', throws TeamGateRefusedError for any other outcome and rethrows a ToolDenied. assertMayAuthor calls it for the unit and stage it already finds, so its behaviour and its three call sites do not change.
acceptanceChecks: the helper asks for 'revise' when the stage is in signoff or changes-requested and for 'author' otherwise, and applies assertHeld for 'revise'
a repo with no team policy resolves with no tracker call
a ToolDenied is rethrown and every other refusal is a TeamGateRefusedError
the existing assertMayAuthor tests pass unchanged

tasks.title: Gate the define extend path before its first write
tasks.summary: In finalizeDefineExtend (src/workflow/orchestrator.ts), after the Epic anchor is resolved and before appendStoryToDefine, call assertMayReviseDraft for the unit {epic, repoPath, epicHash}, stage DEF and authoring 'define'. A refusal throws before the Story, the amendment or the EXT record is written; every existing validation failure still returns first, so the gate does not run for a request that fails anyway. The first define of a fresh Epic is not gated. The test drives the existing define-extend test harness (the orchestrator entry the existing extend tests use) with a stand-in policy reader and tracker port through the gate's test seams; no new export is added unless that harness cannot reach the function.
acceptanceChecks: an extend by someone who is not the holder, while the Define is in signoff, is refused and writes no Story, no amendment and no EXT record
the holder's extend, and an extend in a repo with no team policy, are written as today
a duplicate Story id or an unapproved Epic still fails before the gate is asked
a ToolDenied from the gate stops the run and is not turned into a refusal

src/workflow/__tests__/define-extend-gate.test.ts: a duplicate Story id or an unapproved Epic fails before the gate is asked, and a denied tracker call in the gate stops the run

tasks.title: Gate the review-comment recorder before its first record
tasks.summary: In handleResolveComment (src/workflow/resolve-comment.ts), after the artifact is found and before the first recordResolution, call assertMayReviseDraft once, mapping parseArtifactId's define and hld to the Epic (stages DEF, HLD) and lld to the Story (stage LLD). A TeamGateRefusedError becomes an { error } naming the gate's reason with nothing recorded; a ToolDenied is rethrown. ResolveCommentDeps gains an optional gate seam for tests. Outside signoff the rule asks for 'author', so a comment on an unassigned stage takes the claim as any author turn does; this is tested, not assumed.
acceptanceChecks: a comment from someone who may not revise the stage is answered with an { error } and records nothing
the gate is asked once for several comments and maps define, hld and lld to the right unit and stage
a comment outside signoff by the holder, or on an unassigned stage, behaves as an author turn would (claim taken), and a stage held by someone else is refused
a repo with no team policy records as today
a ToolDenied is rethrown and is not an { error }

testStrategyCoverage.lldStrategyItem: assertMayReviseDraft asks teamGate for 'revise' when the stage is in signoff or changes-requested and for 'author' otherwise, applies assertHeld for 'revise', rethrows a ToolDenied and resolves with no tracker call in a repo with no team policy
the write inventory names a gatedBy entry point or an exemption with a reason for every content entry and site, and the test fails for a content writer with neither

the define extend path refuses when the Epic's Define is in signoff and the actor is not the holder, and writes no Story, no amendment and no EXT record; the holder is allowed and the extend is written as today

handleResolveComment answers an { error } with the gate's reason and records no comment when the stage is in signoff and the actor is not the holder, asks the gate once for several comments, maps define and hld to the Epic and lld to the Story, and records as today in a repo with no team policy
a denied tracker call in the gate is rethrown by both entry points and is not an { error }
